topicPush.title: Push to FCM topic
topicPush.description: Send a web push to devices subscribed to a Firebase topic (all users, a role, or a segment). Users must have registered tokens and correct topic subscriptions.
topicPush.noSegments: No segments exist yet. Create segments under Admin → Segments.
topicPush.confirmAll: This will send to every device subscribed to the all_users topic. Continue?
topicPush.confirmRole: This will send to every device subscribed to the topic for role: {role}. Continue?
topicPush.confirmSegment: This will send to every device subscribed to the segment topic for “{name}”. Continue?
topicPush.confirmCustom: This will send to every device subscribed to custom topic: {topic}. Continue?
